title: Module activity
description: Which modules of the solution are alive and which rest: every module of the cluster partition classed by the age of its newest individual change, with its changes over time — mass events never count as activity.
author: fm-lab core

params.name: person
params.description: Person key from v_change_meta_authors (spelling variants merged).

params.name: days
params.description: Period of the change counts and the chart, counted back from the data state: 30, 90, 365 (default) or all.

params.name: technical
params.description: Technical authors (tools, runtime sessions) in the change counts: hide (default) or include.

params.name: bulk
params.description: Mass events: hide (default) or include — included, a mass stamp dates the newest change like an individual one.

params.name: state
params.description: Class state of the module table: all (default), active, aging, resting, unknown or none.

params.name: sort
params.description: Order of the module table: activity (default), saves or changes.

params.name: module
params.description: Selected module (community number, or file name without a partition): shows its detail card.

params.name: mq
params.description: Search term over the module names of the module table.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of the module table (1-based, 100 rows per page).

params.name: count
params.description: Count mode of the chart: objects (default) or actions (bursts).

params.name: stack
params.description: Series of the chart: module (default here), type, file or person.
